sections.title: Assumptions and limits
paragraphs: This report contains no economics: no payback period, cash flow or feed-in tariff.
The string layout uses Trina Solar TSM-460NEG9R.28 as a reference module; the module you install can change it.
Self-sufficiency figures describe an average household; measured values differ with each household's habits.
Without a roof plane, the yield assumes 35° tilt facing south (HTW Berlin calculator default).
Open-circuit voltage checked at −10 °C cell temperature. (Planning assumption without a published source)
MPP voltage checked at 70 °C cell temperature, with the module's Voc temperature coefficient. (Planning assumption without a published source)
DC cable: 15 m per string and pole until the route is measured. (Planning assumption without a published source)
Two connector pairs per string: one at the array, one at the inverter. (Planning assumption without a published source)

sections.title: Next steps
paragraphs: Add the Linker products to your solution draft and request a Proforma; we reply within one business day.
Before ordering, confirm the string layout with the module you install, the cable routes and the grid connection on site.
